notes: All PNG layers use the exact 894x839 source canvas.
Visible head, ponytail and beard artwork is directly extracted from the original source without resizing or repositioning.
The ears and tusks remain rigidly attached to the head.
The ponytail is a spring layer with subtle secondary motion.
The beard is a separate spring layer with a smaller maximum rotation than the ponytail.
A narrow hidden cloak/neck region behind the head was reconstructed only to support subtle head movement.
Small hidden face/scalp areas beneath the beard and ponytail root were reconstructed only where movement could reveal them.
eyes_closed.png is a full-canvas transparent blink overlay containing only the eye regions.
hair_back, hair_left and hair_right were skipped because separate loose-hair layers do not add useful motion for this portrait.
Normalized pivot coordinates use x=0 left, x=1 right, y=0 bottom, y=1 top.
